## Dictate Prompt
- Writing style now recognizes web apps in your browser: Gmail, Outlook and other webmail use your Email style, WhatsApp/Telegram/Signal Web use Messenger, Teams and Slack use Work Chat. Other tabs keep Default. If Work Chat has not been learned yet, it falls back to Messenger. (GitHub build)
- While Dictate Prompt is thinking, small symbols on the pill show what screen context was sent: the text around the cursor, an image of the front window, or both.
- Replies that start with a label such as "Task:" are no longer cut at abbreviations like "U.S." or "Dr.".

## Recording pill
- The pill, the Dictate Prompt card and the template picker now appear on the display you are working on (the one holding the front app's window), not on whichever display macOS considers main. They also stay above other apps' windows.

## Chat
- Asking the chat to forget something about you now shows an approval card, just like remembering does.
- In Offline Mode the chat no longer offers Google or Trello tools.

## Templates
- One template can hold several related formats, picked by saying the format's name first. The practice playbook is updated (v1.2).

## Installation
Download the DMG from the [releases page](https://github.com/mgsgde/whisper-shortcut/releases), open it, and drag WhisperShortcut to your Applications folder.

**Full changelog:** https://github.com/mgsgde/whisper-shortcut/compare/v9.00...v9.01
